title: Tape support lies within the visited span
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, Boolean input word $x$, time $t\in\mathbb{N}$, work tape $i$, and cell $z\in\mathbb{Z}$, if $z$ lies outside the interval from the leftmost to the rightmost head position visited on tape $i$ through time $t$, then that cell is blank after $t$ steps of the run of $M$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$z\in\mathbb{Z}$ lies outside the visited interval at time $t$
replaced:
For every machine $M$, input $x$, time $t$, work tape $i$, and cell $z$ outside the
visited interval of tape $i$ at time $t$, the cell $z$ of tape $i$ after running $M$ for
$t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$ is blank.
